pilots.cause: CRLF serial receipt did not match the anchored vCPU-thread regex used by that measured source.
pilots.interpretation: Three completed baseline samples remain raw failed-attempt evidence; no values enter the formal performance comparison.

pilots.cause: A 224MiB anonymous allocation did not force enough originally shared GPAs to be reused. The >=128MiB physical-page overlap check failed rather than accepting aggregate allocation size as evidence.
pilots.interpretation: The protocol detached and acknowledged the whole 160MiB original set, but only 12MiB entered the measured anonymous workload. This is insufficient end-to-end reuse coverage, not a reported remap/ACK failure. Raw timings are excluded from formal results.
pilots.follow_up: A separately archived stopped memory smoke used a measured safe 400MiB allocation, reused/changed 38,611 original pages (150.82421875MiB), and informed the fixed 400MiB formal workload.

reporting.finding: A guest serial trace record was interrupted by native POOL_DISCARD_JSON output in the shared stdout log. A clean ftrace ring does not establish intact export.
reporting.corrective_action: Separate the VMM logger via --log-path vmm.log, guest serial stdout via fc.log, and stderr via stderr.log on each boot/restore. stdout/stderr redirection alone is insufficient because the default logger writes stdout.

baseline.interpretation: The diagnostic had no matched do_wp_page calls and was correctly rejected. This does not establish that no CoW occurred.
baseline.source_hypothesis_not_runtime_proven: The caller re-admits/remaps canonical pages but does not read them after admission and before profiling. First-write faults can take do_cow_fault and the custom DAX vmf->cow_page copy path instead of do_wp_page. Root is validating the profiler separately.

pilots.preservation: Original suite and arm statuses and bytes were not rewritten. Both stopped outer runs, receipts and measured sources are archived. No timing from either arm enters formal performance.
